statement: Retrieve objects of a Grasshopper document from within the definition, selecting them by type, by library, by group or all at once.

source.ref: Object retrieval (by type, library, group, or all)

superiority: Dino 8 should expose a typed, read-only document query API with stable object ids so definitions can introspect themselves safely.

acceptance.corpus: Document with 300 components in 12 groups and 3 libraries
acceptance.tolerance: Query by group and by library returns the exact member sets (100 percent precision and recall)

statement: Query details about components, their parameters and the plugin libraries they come from, for example to list a definition's plugin dependencies.

source.ref: Document Info (information about components, parameters and libraries)

superiority: Dino 8 should list every dependency with version and licence and warn on missing plugins when a file opens.

acceptance.tolerance: All 5 dependencies listed with versions; usage counts equal the component counts exactly

statement: Enable or disable components and whole groups from a boolean in the definition, including when they sit inside clusters.
superiority: Dino 8 should make enable states a native, undoable input that works identically inside clusters and with master toggles.

acceptance.corpus: Group of 20 components inside a cluster toggled 100 times, plus one master toggle over 5 groups
acceptance.tolerance: State changes applied in one solve; no stale outputs; 0 failures inside clusters

statement: Switch component preview on or off and change the display colour of groups from definition data.

source.ref: Object manipulation: preview toggle and group colour

superiority: Dino 8 should treat display state as scriptable data with undo and save it with the file.

acceptance.corpus: Toggle preview on 50 components and recolour 5 groups from a list
acceptance.tolerance: Viewport state matches request after 1 solve; undo restores prior state exactly

statement: Write text and numbers to panels and scribbles and change slider properties (range, value, rounding) from other components.

source.ref: Set Panel / Set Scribble / Set Slider Properties

superiority: Dino 8 should support safe writes with loop detection so setting a slider from its own output cannot freeze the solver, fixing the stale range problems users report.

acceptance.corpus: Set a slider's min, max and value from a downstream result
acceptance.tolerance: Value clamped to range; no infinite recompute; slider shows new range immediately

statement: Read the properties of panels and sliders (text, range, current value) as data for use elsewhere in the definition.
superiority: Dino 8 should expose all UI-object properties through a single typed getter with change notifications.

acceptance.tolerance: Returned min, max, value equal the displayed values exactly

notes: A forum thread titled as a wish asks for reading panel and slider properties; confirm availability before treating as an existing capability.

statement: Highlight and locate components on the canvas from the definition, and navigate to objects such as bottlenecks.
superiority: Dino 8 should include a built-in profiler that ranks components by solve time and jumps to them.

acceptance.corpus: Definition with one 2 s component among 200 fast ones
acceptance.tolerance: The slow component ranks first; reported time within 10 percent of a stopwatch measurement

statement: Trigger the solver and button presses from keyboard events or other components, and run definitions through the Grasshopper Player with the same controls.

source.ref: Button trigger / keyboard shortcut / Grasshopper Player support

superiority: Dino 8 should offer first-class keyboard bindings and a headless runner with identical results to the interactive one.

acceptance.corpus: Definition run 20 times headless vs interactive
acceptance.tolerance: Outputs identical (bitwise for numbers, exact for text)

statement: Change the shape and appearance of sketch objects on the canvas from data.
superiority: Dino 8 should treat canvas annotations as scriptable objects with undo.

acceptance.corpus: Resize and recolour 10 sketches from a list
acceptance.tolerance: Sizes equal request within 1 px; undo restores originals

notes: Sketch-shape manipulation is stated in the McNeel Metahopper category description.
